definition: Intended to calm disagreement and encourage a more friendly response.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: At length he made another attempt; and rubbing his hands together, said, in his most conciliatory tone, “And where should you think Bill was now, my dear?”
example_sentence: He came home late with a conciliatory bunch of petrol station flowers.
